Jewar to become electronics manufacturing hub with new projects

Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that Jewar is set to become a significant electronics manufacturing hub. Two new projects worth Rs 6,750 crore will establish facilities for advanced printed circuit boards and HVAC components, aiming to create 3,000 jobs and reduce reliance on imports.
